issues.description: The specification/UML requires a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template provides the corresponding operation under a different name: addItem(StockIngredient). Students following the UML will not find the required method in the starter code, and solution/reference code expects addToStockIngredients to exist.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename template method Stock.addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a public delegating wrapper method addToStockIngredients that calls addItem, so the template matches the UML/spec and solution.

issues.description: The specification/UML defines SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int) and SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) as instance methods, but the text explicitly mandates both methods must be static (and the reference solution implements them as static). This contradiction can cause students to implement the wrong method modifiers and fail structural checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML consistent with the text by marking acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice as static in the diagram (or remove the static requirement from the text if instance methods are intended).
